description: adult man undead king of the slavic underworld, gaunt, very pale skin, sunken cheeks, glowing green eyes, long black hair, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, a towering crown of black antlers and bone, a long tattered robe of black and deep green with glowing green runes, a mantle of dark mist, a chain of small skulls across the chest, holding a tall staff of black bone topped with a glowing green skull lantern, the whole staff inside the image, faint green mist close to the feet, menacing and regal, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same man: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, godlike outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
